claim_scope: Cosmo3D existence and lineage: SGI scene graph halted near beta when SGI pivoted to OpenGL++, shipped only as the substrate beneath OpenGL Optimizer, absorbed into the Fahrenheit program (announced 1997-12-17, dead by 2000); only the XSG scene-graph slice ever shipped, briefly
notes: Verified against Wikipedia (Fahrenheit graphics API, OpenGL++), the TU Wien 3D APIs summary (Cosmo3D released only as part of Optimizer, dropped in favor of OpenGL++), and Game Developer coverage of the Fahrenheit announcement. No standalone Cosmo3D source release is known.
title: Cosmo3D / OpenGL++ / Fahrenheit lineage
